scripts.postinstall: (cd models/ts && npm run build) && (cd models && npm run convert)
scripts.deploy:development: python3 ops/infrastructure/minikube.py && minikube start && npm run minikube:dns && minikube kubectl -- apply -f ops/infrastructure/minikube/minikube.yaml --validate=false && minikube dashboard &>/dev/null
scripts.minikube:tunnel: minikube addons enable ingress && minikube addons enable ingress-dns && minikube tunnel
scripts.minikube:dns: minikube addons enable ingress && minikube addons enable ingress-dns && npx ts-node ops/infrastructure/minikube/minikube-dns.ts
scripts.api:certs: cd api && kubectl cp default/$(kubectl get pods -l app=development-c-lightning-rest -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}' --all-namespaces):/usr/src/app/certs ./certs
scripts.api:development: npm run api:certs && cd api && npm run start:dev
